messages:
Jules (Support): P1 - NyxHealth trial blocked: embeddings return 403 for new analysts after seat migration. Customer has an exec demo in 6 hours and mentioned renewal conversations. Ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-10002 :rotating_light:

Jules (Support): Snippet from proxy logs:
```text
403 Forbidden - quota or token error
org: org-nyx-11
operation: embed.generate
active_users: 19
quota_limit: 12
```

Rae (CS): Looping @Omar and @Maya. I just spoke to Pri (Nyx); they did a seat move and now half the team sees 403s. We need the fastest path to restore access and a short comms note. Renewal at risk if demo fails. :grimacing:

Omar (AM): Billing shows a PO mismatch causing an automated hold on provisioning flows. Legal ETA unclear (24-72h). AM policy allows a short-term "seat bridge" for up to 5 business days with AM approval. I can approve a 12-seat bridge if CS confirms customer acceptance.

Maya (SRE): Two safe ops options: 1) rollback the last seat migration (preferred) via admin rollback; 2) apply a temporary quota bump to cover peak concurrency. Rollback command (internal):
```bash
redwood-admin seats rollback --org org-nyx-11 --job "rb-4932101111" --from analytics --to data-team
```
Quota bump command:
```bash
redwood-admin quota set --org org-nyx-11 --limit 30 --ttl 24h --note "temp unblock - seat migration fallout"
```
Rollback avoids billing edge cases.

Jules (Support): Customer reports ~11 users blocked in last 30m. Pri says they prefer a rollback to avoid billing confusion but wants us to confirm quickly.

Rae (CS): Draft message to Pri: 
"Hi Pri — sorry for the disruption. We can immediately revert the seat migration (fastest) which should restore access, or apply a 24h quota bump if you'd rather keep the new mappings. Which do you prefer? If you want the rollback, I'll schedule it now and confirm when complete. — Rae, CS"

Omar (AM): I'm ok to pre-approve the rollback and will only sign the seat bridge if customer requests the quota bump. Looping finance: billing-bot please note potential short-term manual adj if a seat bridge is used.

billing-bot: Acknowledged. Temporary seat bridges create a prorated adjustment and require AM sign-off; billing ticket BILL-10101 created for reconciliation.

Maya (SRE): I'll attempt a rollback now and will post the job id. If rollback fails, we'll fallback to quota bump. Running rollback (async).

Maya (SRE): Rollback started: job-101393. Post-checks running.

Jules (Support): Adding job id to INC-10002 and attaching HAR + repro steps. Passing to CS for confirmation with customer.

Maya (SRE): Rollback completed. job-101393 status: success. Post-run checks show 17 active sessions reconnected, no errors in the last 10 minutes.

Rae (CS): Message to customer: "Rollback complete — could you try the embedding flow and confirm? We'll keep a watch for 2 hours and coordinate billing follow-up. If anything else pops up, reply here and we'll act immediately."

Pri (Customer) (via email): "Access restored, thanks. Please share what happened; we'll want a short note for our procurement team before renewal talks."

Rae (CS): Action items: 1) Follow up with procurement + AM to resolve PO mismatch (Omar). 2) Log a medium-high renewal risk in Gainsight and schedule a 30m post-demo check-in with the customer. 3) Add an account note about the seat migration risk and recommend a brief onboarding runbook. I'll own comms and the post-demo sync.

Omar (AM): Escalating PO mismatch to our billing ops and procurement sponsor. If legal extends >48h, propose a 3-day seat bridge and reconcile later. Creating escalation TASK-4312.

billing-bot: TASK-4312 noted. BILL-10101 assigned to billing ops for reconciliation after PO clears.

Jules (Support): Closing support incident after CS confirms customer can proceed with demo. Leaving thread for AM/CS follow-up. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
